FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Scholarly Supplies Store, we specialize in retailing educational materials, school supplies, stationery, and art supplies primarily catered towards students, parents, and educators. Our well-organized store layout features a wide selection of products, ensuring that shoppers can easily find what they need for academic success. We maintain our inventory value under $500,000 to limit property loss exposure, employing standard security measures such as locked display cases and adequate lighting throughout the premises to ensure a safe shopping environment. Our knowledgeable staff, comprised of sales associates, inventory managers, and store managers, is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service and product support. We do not offer equipment rentals, in-store workshops, or instructional activities, maintaining a focus on retail sales effectiveness. Additionally, we limit our online sales to less than 25% of total annual revenue, ensuring a manageable e-commerce operation while minimizing cyber risk. Regular inventory assessments and seasonal promotions align with our business cycle, especially during back-to-school and holiday periods. Our commitment extends to compliance with all applicable safety standards, particularly for children’s products to ensure customer safety and comfort.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms that our inventory value remains below $500,000 without the need for a centrally monitored alarm system. We do not provide equipment rentals or lend supplies to customers, nor do we offer any in-store instructional activities, classes, or workshops. Additionally, online sales constitute less than 25% of our total annual revenue.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred on 06/15/2023 due to a break-in that resulted in stolen merchandise valued at $1,200. The incident has been reported to law enforcement and the status is currently open as investigations are ongoing.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade A, UL Listed Safe
